comment: No source is published; the maker's manual is at factionoptions.com/manual. Channel levels and Master Intensity are all configured 0 to 1 with a default of 1, and Normalize is a two-position switch defaulting to Off, which the manual does not say. The CV to DMX scaling is 25.4, so a full 10V at unity level and unity master gives 254 rather than the 255 the range allows. That figure is kept out of the lines. Master Intensity is named chain-wide by the maker and the manual says it applies downstream, but the value this fixture hands to the one on its right is the clamped input voltage, taken before the level and master knobs, so each fixture applies its own. Blackout is checked at the top of each channel and also dims the mute lamps to 0.3 of full.
